concepts.title: Ananda — The Missing Fourth Power

concepts.title: Vyapti — Receptive and Communicative: The Two-Way Door of Mind-to-Mind

concepts.title: Prakāmya — The Reaching Tendril of Knowledge
concepts.excerpt: A chef walks past a plate of food behind a glass case. He doesn't lift the lid.

concepts.title: Vyapti vs. Prakamya: It Comes to You, or You Go to It
concepts.excerpt: You're walking past a glass case in a bakery. The smell hasn't reached you yet — the case is sealed — but you look at the loaf and something in your mouth already knows the crust, the warmth, the slight sour edge of it.

concepts.title: Chitta Record and the Imprint Chain
concepts.excerpt: Hold an old sword in your hands and go quiet. Don't reach for the form, don't rush to name it — just feel the vibrational quality coming off the thing.

concepts.title: Precognition and the Precient Chitta
concepts.excerpt: Look at a still pond at dusk. The sky isn't in the water — and yet the water holds an image of the sky, ready, so that the moment a bird crosses overhead its reflection is already waiting on the surface to receive it.

concepts.title: Allowed to Receive: The Gate as a Faculty
concepts.excerpt: You're on a call with a salesman and you can feel the pull. Not the words — the words are fine — but a kind of suction underneath them, a current trying to slot you into "yes."

concepts.title: Half Our Thoughts Are Borrowings
concepts.excerpt: You wake up flat. Grey. Before coffee, before anything happens, there's a heaviness sitting in your chest, and you've already named it: I'm depressed today.

concepts.title: The Doctor Who Goes Quiet: Diagnosing by Inner Sensing
concepts.excerpt: A patient sits down and says his stomach hurts. The doctor doesn't reach for a chart.

concepts.title: Aishwarya, Ishita, Vashita — Three Degrees of Will
concepts.excerpt: You're walking and the sun is brutal. The thought barely forms — I could use some shade — and a person coming the other way lifts their umbrella over you and keeps pace.

concepts.title: Ishita — Need as Magnetism

concepts.title: Vashita — The Will Closed Into a Fist
concepts.excerpt: There's a person across the room holding the one thing you need. You don't form a vague wish and let it drift.

concepts.title: The Magnetism of Great Men as Chit-Power

concepts.title: The Directional-Consequence Law

concepts.title: Align the Will in Your Inner Parts

concepts.excerpt: It's 6 a. m. The alarm goes. One part of you wants to stay under the blanket.

concepts.title: Mahima and Garima — The Push That Isn't From the Muscle

concepts.title: Laghima — Lightness Before It's Levitation
concepts.excerpt: A man sits in a chair with his arm raised straight up. Not for a minute.

concepts.title: Anima — Freeing the Atoms: Invisibility, Invulnerability, and the Body Let Loose
concepts.excerpt: A Japanese sword-master draws an edge so keen that, laid on a block of wood, it sinks through like the wood were soft butter.

concepts.excerpt: The men have their eight techniques (mercury, breath-retention, corpse-riding).

concepts.excerpt: A medieval Sanskrit text describes a procedure.

concepts.title: God Immanent Justifies the Siddhis — Riches to Receive, Not Defilements to Flee

concepts.title: Siddhis Are a Preview of Future-Normal Humanity — "The Animal Period" Is Us
concepts.excerpt: Picture a clever animal watching a human being solve a problem by thinking it through.

concepts.title: Siddhis and the Attainment Trap
concepts.excerpt: Siddhis are capacities — sometimes called supernatural powers — that emerge from sustained spiritual practice.

concepts.title: The Danger Triangle: Why a Half-Lit Power Is the One That Burns You
concepts.excerpt: Sit through an evening with a mediocre poet and you already know the diagnosis.

concepts.title: Four Principles of Safe Siddhi Use
concepts.excerpt: Imagine a narrow bridge over a drop. You're crossing it anyway — you didn't choose to, you were born on it.

concepts.title: Ego Dissolution as Consciousness-Widening, Not Moralism
concepts.excerpt: Picture a single chair in the middle of a vast empty hall. It's a perfectly good chair.

concepts.title: Credulity Justifies Skepticism — Why the Doubter Is Right and the Powers Are Still Real
concepts.excerpt: A woman sits alone in a hall in front of a famous saint. He looks at her, and his hand goes up — a small, vague gesture, palm turning, the kind of motion that could mean anything or nothing.

concepts.title: Vital-Being Contract Siddhis — The Low Road to Powers
concepts.excerpt: A street magician makes a ring vanish and reappear inside a sealed envelope.

concepts.title: Negative Faith as Self-Limiting Identity

concepts.title: The Ethics of Siddhi Experimentation

concepts.title: Dhāraṇā, Dhyāna, Samādhi = Saṃyama
concepts.excerpt: Concentration deepens in three stages, and Vivekananda describes them as one continuous motion getting deeper.

concepts.title: Signs the Siddhis Are Unfolding

concepts.title: Seizing and Holding: The Integration Discipline

concepts.title: Siddhis as a Continuum, Not Discrete Powers

concepts.title: Concentration as the Direct Method in Integral Yoga

concepts.title: Graded Infusion vs. Premature Experience

concepts.title: Psychic Being as Foundation for Siddhi Safety
concepts.excerpt: Somewhere in you there's a feeling that doesn't come from your circumstances.

concepts.title: The Lab Notebook of Will: Aurobindo's Recorded Experiments

concepts.title: The Siddhis Are Already Native — the Body Is What Dulls Them
concepts.excerpt: Last night, somewhere in a dream, you stood in one place and then you were somewhere else.

concepts.title: Chakra Opening Is Not Spiritual Growth

concepts.title: Discernment of True vs. Distorted Powers

concepts.title: Divine Mother vs. Intermediate Beings: The Power That Frees You and the One That Folds You In

concepts.title: Consciousness and the Vibrational Quality of Place

concepts.title: Mantra, Yantra, Tantra as Technical Means

concepts.title: Raga as a Vehicle for Siddhi-Power

concepts.title: The Chickens Run From Your Voice
concepts.excerpt: A woman named Jessica typed a small confession into the chat box. At night she tells her chickens to roost, and they do — she just thinks it at them and they go up to their perch.
